title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the largest path difference as 3 x 10^-4 cm.

title: Coherence Length Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the coherence length using the formula lambda_c = lambda^2 / delta_lambda.

title: Understanding of Interference
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate an understanding of how path difference relates to the visibility of interference fringes.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent, particularly converting nanometers to centimeters correctly.

title: Path Difference Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a rationale for using a quarter of the coherence length for clear fringe visibility.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect calculations or misinterpretation of the coherence length.
